note: Card 17 (C3a), 2026-11-02. One camera path in four fixed segments for an equirect 360 flight: approach (high over Sde Dov from the NE, the direction of the developer's official aerial THE-1) -> orbit (REUSED: the per-frame poses of habait-ab's running orbit, Habait/flyover/orbit/camera.json, frames 1 .. end_pose.frames[0], ending at node-b-tower) -> hold-facade (a short seamless loop at node-b) -> descend-846 (node-b -> node-e -> node-f -> node-c -> node-d -> 1.5 m outside opening o-5 of unit 846, floor 16). Evaluated by render_segments.py; this file holds anchors, timing and easing only. No second orbit path is defined here.
frame_world: plan-world metres: X right, Y up the plan sheet, Z up, the unit's floor (16) at z 0, ground at -51.2 (= studio 'X = x_cm/100, Y = -y_cm/100'); north at plan bearing 304.4

projection.centre: u 0.5 = the segment's heading (yaw_deg_from_plus_y_cw in camera.json); the camera never pitches or rolls, so the horizon stays at v 0.5. The director's framing (e.g. the orbit's -16 deg pitch at the tower) is kept per frame as view_hint for the player.
projection.engine: Cycles panoramic equirectangular (decision T0: one render per frame, no cube-face seam, GPU OptiX/CUDA on Kaggle; EEVEE has no panoramic camera and the 6-face route needs an OpenGL context that is unproven on Kaggle)

segments.name: approach

from.why: high over Sde Dov from the NE (THE-1 direction), ~22 deg down to the tower

segments.note: frames u = i/N, i = 0..N-1; u = 1 is orbit frame 1, which starts from rest, so the approach eases out to rest there

segments.name: orbit
segments.note: frames 1 .. end_pose.frames[0] of habait-ab's orbit (orbit + its descent spiral into node-b-tower); its 12 static hold frames are replaced by hold-facade. Position and yaw are taken as they are; its pitch becomes view_hint.

segments.name: hold-facade
segments.easing: out-and-back (1 - cos 2 pi u) / 2, u = i/N, i = 1..N
segments.note: 3 s seamless loop: starts and ends at rest at node-b-tower (frame N = the node pose exactly), so frames 1..N repeat while the buyer picks a unit; yaw fixed

segments.name: descend-846
segments.spline: centripetal Catmull-Rom through the anchors on (x, y, z, yaw, hint pitch); arc length eased by smoothstep

end.opening_kind: living -> terrace-living (NOT o-13, the bedroom terrace door)
end.look: inward along -normal_out, into the living room (plan bearing 288.7)

descend_template.note: Card 22 (C6b), 2026-11-02, additive: one descend path per unit group, offset in height per floor; read by Habait/flyover/batch/batch_units.py. render_segments.py does not read this key and the four segments above are unchanged. The base is descend-846 itself: the template at (type L, floor 16) reproduces its 120 poses exactly (batch_units.py checks it on every run).

variables.floor: the unit's floor (units.json); dz = (floor - base_floor) * floor_to_floor_m, which must equal the unit's box_world z0
variables.end_frame: the group's end pose and facade normal: origin = end position at eye height, axis 1 = the facade normal out, axis 2 = along the facade, axis 3 = z

descend_template.start: orbit:end = node-b-tower, the hold-facade pose; shared by every unit and never offset (every descend branches from the hold loop)
descend_template.anchors: the base segment's anchors after the start (node-e, node-f, node-c, node-d) and their look points, expressed in the base end frame (o-5 normal) and re-placed in the group's end frame (rotation about z + translation), then + dz; the end anchor = the group's end pose + dz

end_rule.traced: a group whose footprint is apt846's own (type L: 826/836/846/856/866, units-stacked bay 0): the base end, 1.5 m outside o-5 on the living terrace, eye 1.6, looking in along -normal_out
end_rule.stacked-approx: K/M/PH (units-stacked.json; their footprints and openings are unknown until their plans are traced): the facade = the floor-plate edge (units-geometry.json building.plate_en) hit first by a ray from the unit box centre along that edge's outward normal; the living opening = that foot point on the plate edge; end = 1.5 m outside it along the normal, eye 1.6, looking in

group_key: facade true bearing rounded to 0.5 deg
box_world plan rectangle rounded to 0.05 m
descend_template.output: Habait/flyover/equirect/_local/segments/descend-<unit>/{camera.json, frames/frame_####.png}; global frames = descend-846's (the descends are alternatives at the same place in the flight)
